contract_name: Incident Handling and Failure Isolation Contract
mandatory_workflow: OBSERVE (Detect deviation in operational health check or run metrics)
CAPTURE (Preserve raw HTML, network responses, and DOM logs without modifying code)
REPRODUCE (Create minimal standalone reproduction test script)
CLASSIFY (Distinguish SOURCE_BLOCKED vs EXTERNAL_BEHAVIOR_CHANGE vs ACCOUNTING_DEFECT vs CODE_DEFECT)
LOCATE FIRST DIVERGENCE (Pinpoint exact pipeline stage where divergence originates)
RED TEST (Write failing assertion capturing the defect)
MINIMAL FIX (Implement fix respecting budget: <= 2 production files, 0 dependencies)
REGRESSION SUITE (Verify 94/94 regression suite passes with 0 failures)
TARGETED RECERTIFICATION (Execute certified run on affected marketplace)
PERSIST (Document failure in FAILURES.md and update DECISIONS.md if architectural policy changed)
prohibition: Never apply an in-flight quick-fix without reproducing and isolating first divergence.
